profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have been a full stack software engineer since June of 2021, and specialize in front-end development. Some of my favorite tech I've encountered from tech stacks I've worked on previously have been React.tsx, Ruby on Rails, and Python Jupyter Notebook. Recently, I've been doing primarily React.tsx development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer on the following projects:
- Market survey redesign for compact and optimized user experience
- Creating a new Ruby generated excel data report for users, implementing formulas for customers, specific designs, and filtering 
- Redesign of edit page for property comparisons to improve user experience between the map and data tables
- Building frontend out for new data drilldown modals and drawer displays
- Leading frontend development as the solo frontend engineer on new product teams (Daylight for a year+, two new products as of summer 2026)
- Breaking down large unknown projects into digestible tasks/descriptions and assigning engineers to tasks
- Led discussion on best practices for PR reviewing --> conventional comments / commit messages / descriptions

Other work
- Tech debt tasks of migrating from React Redux to Zustand
- Redesign of insights page
- Bug fixes
- Helping with social and offsite planning
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Elasticsearch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby on Rails · Zustand · Typescript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped to define analytics needs to develop models for tracking. Integrating the built out universal analytics into Cigna's products.

Integrated analytics tracking in React Native (mobile development) as well as on web applications with React/Typescript

Working on restructuring of analytics data exporting project to be in new architecture structure to further abstract processes from each other, and separating out functions of the repository. Used AWS Lambda to test these changes, and make sure the data export was working.

Working with Backstage, Spotify's developer onboarding portal - lead the frontend design and development of Digital's onboarding information for local development as well as onboarding information for managers doing administrative work
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Application Development · Front-End Development · Full-Stack Development · User Experience Design (UED) · Figma (Software) · Communication · Web Applications · Adobe XD · React.js · Git · Web Analytics · Code Review · Microservices · React Native · Web Technologies · Problem Solving · Typescript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Head developer for building map search app for mobile devices using React

Launched new customer admin

Planned, coded, reviewed, A/B tested, and launched new feature for Rentable.co marketplace such as:
- Favoriting functionality and page on mobile site
- Built user management page for ApartmentIQ.io
- Created new facet marketplace pages with unique data features
- Built workers to run nightly to determine pages' indexing status

Built data scraper for grabbing apartment information from competitors

Built out related properties email for customers

Researched, tracked, and implemented SEO strategies for Rentable.co

Helped with company culture and growth
- Created LGBTQ+ safe space group
- Led LGBTQ+ book club discussion for engineering team
- Presenting SEO strategies to entire company
- Hosted and planned virtual social events for engineering team
- Led engineering interviews
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Data Analytics · Python (Programming Language) · Front-End Development · Communication · Web Applications · React.js · Git · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Code Review · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby on Rails · Web Development · Web Technologies · Problem Solving
